items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 30:1
items.html: The first coupling of AVI is when they are in their place, and ZON ascend to them and receive the Mochin that come out of that coupling. And there is a second coupling of AVI, in which AVI descend to the place of YESHSUT and ZON and clothe in ZON, and the coupling is made in the place of ZON. And these Mochin are only for the AVI of Beriah. (Item 193).
